boost.name: Household Chores
effect: Discard your Gauge. Add that many cards plus one more from the top of your deck to your Gauge.

name: Maori Defender

boost.name: Warm Wishes
effect: Draw until you have as many cards in hand as your opponent.
HIT: You may play a boost that does not cause a Strike for free. If it is a Continuous boost, do not discard it after this Strike.

name: Gale Blade

boost.name: Returning Weapon
effect: Draw a card. Swap a card from your hand for a card in your Gauge.
HIT: You may put a copy of this card from your discard into your Gauge.

name: Focus Charge

boost.name: Possession
effect: Add up to 3 cards from your hand to your Gauge.
BEFORE: Close 3 spaces. +1 Power for each space you weren't able to close.
AFTER: Push the opponent 1 space per point of damage dealt with this attack.

name: Gut Shot
effect: HIT: Retreat 1 space and gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).

name: Tsunami Slicer
effect: HIT: You may pay 1 Gauge to gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).

name: Neo Cosmic Flare

boost.name: An Apple A Day
effect: Draw 3 cards. Add one to your Gauge.
BEFORE: Spend up to 12 Force for +1 Power per Force spent.
